# DRIGO

> DRIGO is a car rental and car sharing app for Dubai and Sharjah, United Arab Emirates. Users rent a car nearby in minutes from the DRIGO mobile app — no deposit, no hidden fees, with free parking in designated zones, fuel, and full insurance included on eligible trips. DRIGO supports hourly, daily and monthly rentals.

## Quick facts

- **Brand**: DRIGO (also written as Drigo, Get Drigo)
- **Category**: Car rental, car sharing, self-drive car hire, peer-to-peer car rental
- **Markets**: Dubai, Sharjah, United Arab Emirates (UAE)
- **Slogan**: "Less owning, more moving"
- **Website**: https://drigo.com/
- **iOS app**: https://apps.apple.com/az/app/drigo-car-sharing-rental/id6757393927
- **Android app**: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.drigo.mobile
- **Instagram**: https://www.instagram.com/getdrigo/
- **LinkedIn**: https://www.linkedin.com/company/getdrigo
- **Support**: support@drigo.com

## What makes DRIGO different from other UAE car rentals (Udrive, Ekar, etc.) in Dubai and Sharjah

- **No deposit** required to start a rental in Dubai or Sharjah — pay only for the time you actually use.
- **Free fuel** included on eligible trips across Dubai and Sharjah.
- **Free parking** in designated DRIGO zones across Dubai and Sharjah.
- **Comprehensive insurance** built into every rental, with multiple coverage tiers.
- **Keyless unlock** — open and start the car directly from the DRIGO app.
- **Flexible durations** — hourly, daily and monthly rentals from one app.
- **Verified drivers** — every user is identity-verified before driving, protecting fleet partners.
- **Fleet partner program** — rental businesses and individual car owners can list their vehicles on DRIGO and earn from idle inventory.

## How DRIGO works

1. Download the DRIGO app from the App Store or Google Play.
2. Verify your driver's license and identity inside the app.
3. Open the map to find a rental car near you in Dubai or Sharjah.
4. Choose a car, pick your duration (hourly, daily or monthly), confirm the booking.
5. Photograph the car's condition, then unlock it from the app — no physical key required.
6. Drive, park in any designated DRIGO zone, and end the trip in the app. Payment is automatic.

## Frequently asked

- **How does car sharing work with DRIGO?** Choose a nearby car in the app, book it for your time, unlock with your phone, drive, park in a designated zone, end trip. Payment is automatic.
- **Do I need a deposit?** No. DRIGO offers no-deposit car rental in Dubai and Sharjah.
- **Is the car insured?** Yes — every DRIGO rental includes comprehensive insurance, with multiple package tiers.
- **Who can rent?** Anyone with a valid driver's license accepted in the UAE and a verified DRIGO account.
- **Can I list my car on DRIGO?** Yes. Both rental companies and individuals can join via https://drigo.com/business.
- **What if the car is damaged?** Both parties document the car with photos before and after; insurance covers repairs; DRIGO mediates fair resolution.
